SELECT id, number, title, content, tags, difficulty, time_limit, memory_limit, judge_case_sample, judge_case_url, submit_num, accepted_num, create_time, update_time,
( (CASE WHEN number = #{keyword} THEN 100 WHEN number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 60 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) ) AS search_score FROM question WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY search_score DESC, create_time DESC
